macros.name: fixediddots
macros.doc: LaTeX and plainTEX don’t have the other diagonal, so we provide a \fixediddots which is just \fixedddots with the boxes reversed.

macros.name: originalddots
macros.doc: On the chance that some other package changes the behavior before mathdots is loaded, use \originalddots, \originalvdots, and \originaliddots to obtain the versions in force before mathdots is loaded.
